message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads datasets via a local Data wrapper with no visible checksum verification, signed URL validation, or authentication of any remote data source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only checks that unique labels in train and test match via assert_array_equal, but performs no label distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples anywhere in the data preparation code path.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates classifiers directly from sklearn and custom modules without loading any serialized/pretrained weights, so no integrity verification (hash, signature, or pinned revision) is performed or needed here.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path passes data directly to classifiers and calibrators without any input shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (predicted probabilities) are aggregated and returned without any NaN guards, bounds checks, or sanity validation on the probability values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML classifiers (not LLMs), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
